Review Zing AI Fitness Coach?

Zing AI Fitness Coach earns praise for approachable, highly personalized workouts, clear progress tracking, and motivating AI guidance that adapts to energy, goals, and limitations. Users highlight friendly onboarding, reminders, and the Body Scan as standouts, with some sharing notable weight-loss results and daily use. Critiques focus on missing basics: rest-timer alerts, robust exercise library, logging reps/sets/weights, and better variety to avoid repetitive programming; multitasking pauses timers. A maker behind Zing notes consistent motivation and fit-to-level plans, reinforcing trust while users anticipate continued feature upgrades.
